decisions.reason: The seventy-two-hour express program still builds on the firm's core production, planning, and service capabilities, so management can keep learning and refining it, although the operational demands of ultra-fast delivery leave some withdrawal risk.
The fire-resistant steel exterior door is tightly connected to the firm's established engineering, certification, and safety knowledge, which makes continued improvement and retention highly likely.

The express delivery line for doors and gates fits the firm's modular product base and service model well, giving it good capacity to absorb customer feedback and optimize the range rather than abandon it.

The online ordering and digital services platform supports the firm's strategic push toward deeper service integration, but adoption, process integration, and digital capability-building still create a moderate chance of withdrawal.
The fire and smoke protection door remains highly complementary to the firm's compliance, safety, and in-house R&D strengths, so it is a natural product area to retain and develop further.
